title: sse: fix partial-JSON delimiter ordering and chunking to preserve token/event ordering
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: Streaming SSE events for structured output (OpenAI-compatible responses and internal tool/function-calling) occasionally emitted event delimiters and partial JSON token fragments in an order that could break streaming JSON parsers. This manifested as: 1) trailing 'data: ' delimiter emitted before prior token chunk finished, 2) partial JSON object pieces split across SSE events with delimiter tokens reordered, and 3) downstream parsers failing to recover when array/object delimiters arrived out-of-order. Motivation: customer reports and internal fuzzing (ENG-2741) showed these cases produce incorrectly parsed tool call payloads and corrupted structured outputs. Change summary: - Fix chunking algorithm to prefer token-boundary-aware splits for UTF-8 token sequences and JSON structural characters (" , {, }, [, ], :, ,). - Ensure event delimiter ("data: " / double-newline) emission is strictly ordered after any buffered token chunks are flushed; added a small state machine to guarantee delimiter->chunk ordering. - Add a buffering pass that coalesces small fragments to avoid emitting JSON structural characters in separate events when downstream parsers expect contiguous tokens. - Add extensive unit/integration tests and a replay test using recorded streaming traces from incidents. - Update OpenAI-compat layer to reframe partial-json heuristics and add a compatibility toggle for legacy clients. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce failure locally with recorded trace - [x] Implement token-boundary-aware chunking - [x] Add strict delimiter ordering state machine - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] Run end-to-end against openai-compat test harness - [x] Update changelog/release notes Related: Linear ENG-2741, ENG-2760; Support ticket SUP-4421. No API contract changes. Rolling restart recommended for Dedicated pools where older runtime threads may keep stale SSE framing behavior. If customers cannot restart, a temporary compatibility toggle is available in the compatibility config (openai_compat.partial_json_strict=false).

release_notes: Fixes streaming SSE framing where partial JSON tokens and event delimiters could be emitted out-of-order, causing downstream parsers (including OpenAI-compatible clients) to mis-parse structured outputs. Backwards-compatible toggle added: openai_compat.partial_json_strict=false. Rolling restart recommended for Dedicated deployments. No user-visible API changes.
